Engineering

اختبار صمام عدم الرجوع

A procedural check to verify that a non-return (check) valve allows fluid flow in only one direction, preventing backflow in piping systems.

Quick answer: A procedural check to verify that a non-return (check) valve allows fluid flow in only one direction, preventing backflow in piping systems.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from IMO SMCP, STCW Convention, SOLAS, COLREG and published by Protermify Maritime as a static maritime reference page.

Definition

A procedural check to verify that a non-return (check) valve allows fluid flow in only one direction, preventing backflow in piping systems.

Operational example

Chief engineer, conduct non-return valve test on ballast line and confirm that there is no backflow during pump shutdown.

Localized term
